description: Import a file into the library. Two modes: (1) by URL — pass `url` (HTTPS direct-download, 200MB cap, e.g. Dropbox/Canva); (2) by base64 — pass `data` (raw bytes, 3MB cap) + `mimeType`. Use `source: 'direct'` for base64 uploads from agent memory.

bytes.description: Optional file size in bytes for early rejection

data.description: base64-encoded file bytes, 3MB raw max (mutually exclusive with `url`)

name: import_media
title: Import media
